scope: M21 implementation handoff only; runtime and source fidelity have not been validated

interface.props: Frozen Viewer3DProps retained without contract edits: part, example, on_select_example, on_open_source, debug, show_section
interface.composition: PartPage owns 3D tab visibility, forwards the optional requested example, and shares the same viewer in embedded and standalone panels. Viewer keeps user example selection locally and invokes on_select_example when provided.
interface.asset_boundary: Only available/stale ModelExample entries with GLB metadata; canonical same-origin /api/models/D-NNN_A.glb through D.glb. Fetches bytes without browser cache, aborts cancelled work, validates self-contained GLB 2 headers and refuses external model resources. No invented geometry or fallback solids.
interface.defaults: An explicit example is honored, including honest Unavailable when absent. A current evidence-bound human-confirmed model.selected_example is the next choice, followed by first saved printed example in A/B/C/D order. Changing the viewing choice writes no review decision.
interface.review: Customer labels use the frozen customer_review_status helper with independently present source hashes. Current template disagreement, stale state, missing review, incomplete AI provenance or unverified fallback cannot confer review. A human choice of B does not label A human reviewed. Engineering messages and weight details stay in optional Debug.
interface.rendering: Actual Three GLTFLoader, WebGLRenderer and OrbitControls, neutral grey materials, actual transformed bounds Fit, orbit/pinch/wheel and explicit zoom buttons; on-demand rendering without an idle loop.
interface.lifecycle: Each model/retry/part change and unmount aborts fetch, cancels pending animation/timer, disconnects resize observation, removes listeners/controls, disposes scenes/geometries/materials/textures/bitmaps/skeletons/render lists/renderer and releases the context and URLs. Late parsing results are disposed. Neutral-material parser hook suppresses image/texture requests before loading. Network, malformed/empty GLB, graphics startup and context loss have clean Unavailable/retry states.
interface.m3: Overall size is displayed only from valid model.overall_size_mm metadata, clipping only when section_view_available and show_section permit it, and canonical STEP reconstruction download only when selected asset metadata declares STEP. Clipping adds no cap or fabricated solid.

Exact diagnostics retained in lockfile-process.json. The unchanged metadata-only npm command then exited 0; no package installation, version substitution or local build.
